feedback: Written before this candidate has raced. Iteration 7 (y = 0.08 m, wheel_track 0.12 m, kp 5.0) scored 57.50, with s-bend progress 0.1496 and max_error 0.063 m, oval progress 0.161 and rms_error 0.020, and steering_oscillation at most 0.144 on any track. Iteration 6 to 7 showed forward lead is on a plateau. Iteration 3 showed kp 5.0 against kp 5.0 gives identical results, so gain is not the s-bend lever. Iteration 4 cut slalom progress to 0.035 with a 20 mm pitch and was confounded by the 0.10 m track and 0.6 kg mass, so the drivetrain effect has never been isolated. Your iteration 8 candidate changes only wheel_track to 0.10 m at mass 0.8 kg, which is the clean test. I built it with the iteration 7 controller unchanged, so the result reflects the drivetrain alone. Decide the next step from the race. If s-bend progress rises clearly above 0.16 with steering_oscillation below 0.16 and the oval near 0.16, keep wheel_track 0.10 m and test 0.08 m (the contract minimum). If steering_oscillation rises above 0.16 with line loss unchanged, the turn rate is now too high, so the Integrator should reduce kp before you change geometry; a midpoint track of 0.11 m is the geometry fallback. If s-bend progress is flat or worse, the drivetrain lever is exhausted at y = 0.08 m, so revert to wheel_track 0.12 m and accept this platform.
